create_visualcloze_pipeline: create a VisualClozePipeline instance with transformer, vae, text encoders, and scheduler components
run_visualcloze_generation: run the VisualClozePipeline to generate images from task prompt, content prompt, and visual in-context examples
upsample_generated_images: upsample generated images to higher resolution using SDEdit with configurable strength and dimensions
validate_pipeline_inputs: validate pipeline inputs including strength range, dimension divisibility, prompt consistency, and sequence length
configure_generation_parameters: configure generation parameters such as num_inference_steps, guidance_scale, generator seed, and max_sequence_length
